CodBi_NoFutureDate.description: Apply to an XTextField with datatype='dateDE'. Prevents selecting future dates.

CodBi_DateFrame_1_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN (minimum) date field of a date range pair. Reference the end date via MaxField parameter.

CodBi_DateFrame_1_End.description: Apply to the END (maximum) date field of a date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_2_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN date field of a second date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_2_End.description: Apply to the END date field of a second date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_3_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN date field of a third date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_3_End.description: Apply to the END date field of a third date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_4_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN date field of a fourth date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_4_End.description: Apply to the END date field of a fourth date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_5_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN date field of a fifth date range pair.

CodBi_DateFrame_5_End.description: Apply to the END date field of a fifth date range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_1_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN (minimum) time field of a time range pair. Reference the end time via MaxField parameter.

CodBi_TimeFrame_1_End.description: Apply to the END (maximum) time field of a time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_2_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN time field of a second time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_2_End.description: Apply to the END time field of a second time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_3_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN time field of a third time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_3_End.description: Apply to the END time field of a third time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_4_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN time field of a fourth time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_4_End.description: Apply to the END time field of a fourth time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_5_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN time field of a fifth time range pair.

CodBi_TimeFrame_5_End.description: Apply to the END time field of a fifth time range pair.

CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Date.description: Apply to the DATE input field of a date/time pair. The input field tagged with the Date.Time.Join functionality will receive the combined date + time.

CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Time.description: Apply to the TIME input field of a date/time pair. The input field tagged with the Date.Time.Join functionality will receive the combined date + time.

CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_Begin.description: Apply to the BEGIN date input field of a date/time span. Referenced by the Date.Time.Join.Span functionality; the data-cb-Begin parameter takes precedence.

CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_Begin_Time.description: Apply to the BEGIN time input field of a date/time span. Referenced by the Date.Time.Join.Span functionality; the data-cb-BeginTime parameter takes precedence.

CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_End.description: Apply to the END date input field of a date/time span. Referenced by the Date.Time.Join.Span functionality; the data-cb-End parameter takes precedence.

CodBi_Date_Time_Join_Span_End_Time.description: Apply to the END time input field of a date/time span. Referenced by the Date.Time.Join.Span functionality; the data-cb-EndTime parameter takes precedence.

CodBi_Holidays_Listing.description: Apply to an XSelect that should be filled with holidays for current and next years. The state is specified in global variable CodBi_Holidays_States.
